name: Sponsored Merchant 3
definition: Merchant using the payment services of the card acceptor. The sponsored merchant is not acting as the card acceptor; the latter remaining the only party liable for the transaction vis-à-vis the acquirer.

Assigner.name: Assigner
Assigner.definition: Entity in charge of assigning an identification to a party.

Foreign.name: Foreign
Foreign.definition: Identify when the sponsored merchant is not located in the same country as the marketplace or sponsor.

CommonName.name: Common Name
CommonName.definition: Contains the full name of the sponsored merchant.

LegalCorporateName.name: Legal Corporate Name
LegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the sponsored merchant.

AdditionalAddress.name: Additional Address
AdditionalAddress.definition: Additional information used when card acceptor street address is insufficient.

GeographicLocation.name: Geographic Location
GeographicLocation.definition: Location of the acceptor in latitude/longitude decimal degrees.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of data in the current component.
